name: MCode 技能包
description: 从 MiniMax Code 方法论移植的一组纯提示词技能：元技能 skill-creator / skill-refiner（让 Agent 帮你把重复工作流沉淀成可复用技能）、结构化 compaction 摘要格式、项目 AGENTS.md 初始化、代码审查、深度研究、X 链接阅读、可视化页面。不注册任何工具、不申请文件与网络权限。

en.name: MCode Skill Pack
en.description: A set of prompt-only skills ported from MiniMax Code methodology: the meta-skills skill-creator / skill-refiner (so the agent can turn a repeated workflow into a reusable skill), the structured compaction summary format, AGENTS.md project init, code review, deep research, X link reading and visual pages. Registers no tools and requests no filesystem or network permission.
en.safetyNotes: This plugin contributes instruction documents only. It declares the single permission agent.prompt.inject, which lets the skill catalog enter the agent's prompt; skill bodies are read on demand. It registers no agent tool, runs no command, reads no project file, makes no network request and stores nothing. The skills themselves only describe procedures — the agent still uses its normal, separately-permissioned tools when following them.
